claims.description: Working independent hardware limiter prevents this selected overdelivery event
Working deviation sensing prevents the event when its shared under-reading mode is absent
A functioning processor watchdog guarantees safe flow
Independent monitor fault is necessary to miss overdelivery

interpretation: The same sensor under-reading event is reused in initiation and monitoring; multiplying it twice would understate the probability. A watchdog observes processor liveness, so BE6 is intentionally unused for running-but-wrong output. Clamp free-flow protection, actual flow dynamics, clinical risk, and physical independence require separate tests.
basis: Authored correction of the preserved gallery hazard model. Boolean event meanings and parameter scenarios are proposed teaching abstractions, not accepted field data.
